verdict.rationale: Mollie's docs lay out a clear path to a working payment flow. The Payments API is described as the heart of the API, and hosted checkout is the simplest integration depth. An isolated test mode lets you walk through payments without real money, and webhooks are documented for status updates, which supports self-serve integration from docs alone. However, the pack never shows copy-paste code samples, official SDKs or per-language snippets, and nothing evidences the under-a-day timeline. Missing for 10: documented copy-paste examples or client libraries in multiple languages, hands-on or independent corroboration of time-to-first-payment, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s)
